en: Drag account rows in Subscription Accounts to set their order, or use the up and down buttons. Prism saves the order on this device and immediately shows it in the Execution Account menu. Each task keeps its own automatic handoff order.
Account labels show the provider once when a nickname already begins with its name.
zh: 在「订阅账号」里拖动账号行，或用上下箭头调整顺序。棱镜会在本机记住顺序，并立即同步到「执行账号」下拉。每条任务仍有独立的自动接续顺序。
账号备注以平台名开头时，选择账号的界面只显示一次平台名。
